stage_results.result: /sys/kernel/mm/hugepages: No such file; /proc/sys/vm/nr_hugepages: No such file; /sys/devices/system/node: No such file; (no /proc/config.gz)
fd_numa_linux.c(50): opendir( "/sys/devices/system/node" ) failed (2-ENOENT) + fd_cpu_topo.c(17): fopen failed '/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu1/online' (2-ENOENT) — KERNEL GATE

root_cause_of_run_failure: OrbStack's kernel (7.0.14-orbstack) does not expose /sys/devices/system/node (NUMA sysfs) NOR /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuN/online (CPU topology sysfs) NOR /sys/kernel/mm/hugepages (hugetlbfs sysfs). These are kernel-config-level absences (CONFIG_NUMA / CONFIG_HUGETLBFS not built), NOT privilege issues: no --privileged, no sysctl, and no Kurtosis cap setting can create sysfs the kernel does not expose. The fork's NUMA-fabrication fallback (fd_numa_linux.c deviation #6) warns and synthesizes node 0, but fd_cpu_topo.c separately requires /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuN/online and fails with ENOENT before configure init completes.
limits_of_this_result: This is Frankendancer (fdctl+embedded Agave), NOT full Firedancer. Per AGENTS.md, Frankendancer reuses Agave execution/consensus and is not an independent SVM oracle.

The build-evidence path (fdctl version) succeeds in a Kurtosis container; the validator run path (fdctl run) is BLOCKED at the OrbStack kernel gate. This is 'built' evidence in a Kurtosis container, NOT 'started'/'joined'/'voting'.
6 tracked source-deviation files remain (5 GCC-12 casts + 1 NUMA fallback); this is a source-deviation build, not clean upstream.
Kurtosis ServiceConfig in 1.20.0 does not accept platform/security_opt/cap_drop; cpu_allocation/memory_allocation are omitted because OrbStack cgroup v2 rejects the cpu.max quota Kurtosis writes.

On a dedicated bare-metal x86_64 Linux host (or a standard-kernel QEMU VM) exposing real NUMA sysfs + hugepages + /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuN/online, the same Kurtosis launcher's real_run=True path is the path to started/joined/voting. This host cannot provide that.
